entries.title: Reconcile payments against your payment gateway
entries.summary: a new **Reconciliation** tab on Awards and event invoices puts each invoice next to your gateway's own record of the charge: both statuses side by side, the processor's charge ID, a link to its hosted receipt, and a result saying whether the two agree. **Needs attention** narrows the table to the payments that disagree, and the organization-wide Awards export adds the charges your gateway processed that have no invoice at all.

entries.title: Tree fields open the next level in one click
entries.summary: picking a value that has sub-values now reveals the level below it immediately, instead of taking a second click to expand. A new **only allow selecting the last level** field setting makes the upper tiers navigation-only, so every stored answer is a specific end value, and exports with several tree answers now join them with a pipe — the same separator an import file uses, so an export can be edited and re-imported.

entries.title: Reviewer recommendations on evaluations
entries.summary: evaluators can mark each submission **Accept**, **Decline**, or **Alternate** alongside their scores; Alternate proposes new values for fields you choose (Format, Track, …) plus a note. Counts roll up in a Recommendations column on the plan's Submissions tab.

entries.title: Reviewer session builds
entries.summary: let evaluators propose combining their assigned abstracts into full sessions, within a per-reviewer quota you set per session type. Proposals land on a new **Builds** tab where you approve — creating the real session with the abstracts as subsessions — or decline with a reason.

entries.title: Sort by score and saved views for evaluators
entries.summary: evaluators can sort their queue by the score they've given and save named filter + sort combinations per round, with a starred default that applies automatically.

entries.title: Suppression list for email campaigns
entries.summary: see every address your event can no longer email, why each one was blocked, and clear a block once the cause is fixed. The list separates addresses that genuinely **Bounced** from those caught by a **Send failure**, where an entire message was rejected before sending — usually an unverified sending domain — so nobody received it and nothing bounced. Campaign run history now names which of the two skipped a recipient.

entries.title: Maritz RTS connector
entries.summary: pull registrant profiles from Maritz Real-Time Services onto existing event contacts: job title, company, bio, and registration state stay current automatically on a 10-minute schedule. Inbound only — registrants match by Registrant ID then email, unmatched registrants are skipped and logged, and contacts are never auto-created.

entries.title: Embeds in your visitors' language
entries.summary: every embed widget can now render in English, German, French, or Spanish: labels, buttons, search, and dates translate, and session titles, descriptions, and field values follow your event's [language variants](/settings/language-translation-variant) with automatic fallback for anything untranslated. Set a default in Style Options, or paste a per-language snippet on each localized page — one embed serves them all.

entries.title: Choose which participant roles embeds show
entries.summary: a new Participant Roles setting in the embed builder controls which roles appear across all widgets, including any custom roles you've created. Participants are grouped under their role name on session cards and pop-out views.

entries.title: Subsession details in embeds
entries.summary: visitors can click a subsession inside a session's pop-out view to open its own detail view with its time, location, description, and participants.
